column1: # Abbreviations and signs of units read after a number: "5 км" -> "пять килом+етров". Tab-separated columns:
#   1. the abbreviation as written, case-sensitive, without a final dot (a dot right after it belongs to it);
#   2. the noun: its nominative singular from nouns.tsv, stress marks may be left out;
#   3. optional: words spoken after the noun ("в час").
# A currency sign may stand before the number too: "$20". An abbreviation of several words has single spaces where
# the text has spaces: "мм рт. ст".
